_comment: Hand-authored lore-hub settlement list (board #3665, realm blocks from #3666). One row per named hub: `state` is a human label (logs only), `hub` is city|port|farm|mine|wood, `name` is the display text, `anchor` is a canvas [x,y] pixel that generate_provinces.py seeds a distinct province at and generate_land_regions.py picks as that state's hub. Identity is the anchor geometry, never a stored STATE_ key. `source` is a canon citation (`canon: cr_oldworld_campaign/<slug> (TWW3 Old World mod region table)` or `canon: <place>, <region> (Warhammer Fantasy lore)`) or the literal `invented`. Optional `stack_on: <host hub>` (board #3666) marks a hub that gets no province of its own: its anchor is exactly the host row's anchor, it is named and indexed but seeds nothing. Anchors sit on Chris's painted city dots (`full.ora#cities`) where a dot exists, else >= 20 px from every same-state dot, never on impassable paint. Blocks are contiguous per realm, in state-file order: 02_empire.txt (#3666, 47 states / 220 hubs), 03_brettonia.txt (#3667, 37 states / 172 hubs), 00_norsca.txt + 01_kislev.txt (#3668, 65 states / 300 hubs), 04_karaz_ankor.txt (#3669, 63 states / 266 hubs), 05_southern_realms.txt + 06_badlands.txt (#3670, 63 states / 281 hubs; STATE_LAND_382 is a keep_whole archipelago and carries no rows), 07_nehekhara.txt (#3671, 9 states / 43 hubs).
